text: This report provides a summary of the security trends occurring on the Exhibition Place property, the severity of these incidents, when the incidents are occurring and how they correlate to grounds visitation based on a quarter by quarter and a year over year comparison. At its meeting of March 22, 2018, the Board considered the Exhibition Place Security Report – Year End 2017 statistics and referred the item to the Chief Executive Officer for a report to the next meeting of the Board to provide more information relating to these statistics and the increase in Level 3 and 4 incidents specifically during the Third Quarter of 2017. This report also provides a summary of the security trends occurring on the Exhibition Place property.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (May 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in the Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential in its entirety and not be released publicly as it pertains to the security of the property of the Board.
